claim_scope: One continuous Luna trajectory on three visible Harvey LAB development tasks. Do not pool with canonical Claude-product A/B cells, unseen tasks, or differently judged scores.

launch_amendment.reason: The first sandboxed launch strings omitted the codex: provider prefix and failed at network fetch before any model response or result artifact. Before any authorized live call, the commands were corrected to match the already preregistered performer_model and the user-authorized Codex pathway. No model, prompt, source, arm, output path, or acceptance rule changed.

held_constant.source_selection_policy: After a truthful Glob inventory, the model chooses complete, targeted, or mixed reads. The host applies one request-independent cumulative complete-text budget and no task classifier.
held_constant.durability_policy: Exact source bytes, extracted text, versions, hashes, pinpoints, provider receipts, tool results, and authored artifacts remain host-side. No model-facing evidence union is mounted.

dynamic_fingerprint_policy: Each result must preserve the exact task, source bundle, original instructions, system-prompt variants, tool-schema variants, harness sources, runtime configuration, provider tier, and composite SHA-256 fingerprints generated by the sealed run. Uploaded document IDs make dynamic prompt hashes unknowable before launch.

launch_policy: Write and parse this registration, recheck every listed source fingerprint, then launch the three performer calls concurrently without changing code or prompts.

validity.required_outputs: Every requested DOCX is evaluator-readable and has an exact bytes/SHA-256 receipt from a durable authored Library artifact, not answer-text fallback.

trace_inspection_before_scoring: Verify all static and dynamic fingerprints and default-tier receipts.
Verify one outer provider invocation, continuous reasoning/tool items, no hidden phase reset, and no checkpoint, handoff, union, or SLA events.
Inspect source inventory, complete-read selection responses, bounded Read/Grep continuations, duplicate-read behavior, tool errors, and progressive-disclosure schema changes.

Inspect which source documents and exact spans were exposed before drafting, whether evidence and mutation calls were separated, and whether every deliverable came from a successful authoring receipt.
Classify any defect as general harness, retrieval, synthesis, authoring/compiler, or evaluator compatibility. Only a general structural defect may create a newly preregistered version before scoring.

comparable_coding_finalist.caveat: Retained a context handoff and is not a true one-trajectory pure-coding cell.

acceptance_gate.strict_win: At least 150/217 aggregate, no task more than five points below upstream, and no more than 1,436,478 aggregate provider-reported total tokens.
acceptance_gate.quality_dominant_candidate: At least 160/217, no catastrophic task regression, and no more than 2,154,717 aggregate tokens. This earns wider validation but is not a production win on three visible tasks.
acceptance_gate.reporting_order: Accuracy first; then context/tokens, latency, coverage, cache behavior, context rounds, and tool use.
